hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); case "${f#$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/}" in /*|node_modules/*|.next/*|openspec/*|.claude/*|.devcontainer/*|.github/*) exit 0;; esac; [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/package.json" ] || exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && pnpm exec prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f" && pnpm exec eslint --no-warn-ignored "$f" >&2 || exit 2
